name: Dual Contouring
definition: A surface extraction algorithm that generates a mesh by placing a single vertex inside each cell containing an isosurface intersection, determined by minimizing a Quadratic Error Function (QEF) based on surface normals at intersection points.
summary: Dual Contouring extracts isosurfaces by placing a single optimized vertex per intersected grid cell, preserving sharp features unlike Marching Cubes.
